statements.quote: Q2 data center revenue increased 18% quarter-over-quarter to $89 billion with strong contributions from both subsegments; hyperscale and ACIE, which includes our neocloud, industrial, and enterprise customers.
statements.notes: Quarterly figure (Q2 fiscal 2027), not full-year data center revenue. The hyperscale ($49B, p02) and ACIE ($40B, p04) subsegment figures are parts of this total and are not recorded separately, to avoid double counting.

statements.quote: Our Grace CPU, introduced in 2021, has been a great success, with revenue on a trailing 12-month basis, exceeding $5 billion.
statements.notes: 'Exceeding $5 billion' is a lower bound, recorded as 5B. The period is a trailing 12 months, not a named fiscal year. This is data-center CPU revenue and is likely already included in data center revenue.

statements.quote: For the full year, we now expect OpEx to grow in the low-50s, driven by a broadening of our product portfolio and further increase in the usage of AI tools, which has already and will continue to enhance engineering productivity.
statements.notes: Total opex growth (low-50s %), partly driven by the usage of AI tools. The AI part is not quantified. 'The full year' refers to the current fiscal year, fiscal 2027, as the sentence states it.
